Plain requests blocked; curl_cffi impersonate='chrome120' worked on every fetch this session (17 URLs, 0 failures, no retries needed this time). Nav discovery: /cp/pet-care/2011 ('Pet Care' department landing page) embeds a HubSpokesNxM 'Shop by Category' module in __NEXT_DATA__ (JSON is minified here, no spaces after colons, so the regex from the prior pass's notes had to be adjusted) listing 18 tiles; drilled into the two sub-hub pages it links (/cp/dogs/2012, /cp/cats/2026), each with their own HubSpokesNxM module, plus /cp/pet-medication/30001795 which instead carries a StaticNavigationPills module pointing to /browse/pet-wellness/6400172. All leaf tiles resolved to /browse/<slug>/<catId> PLPs whose __NEXT_DATA__ props.pageProps.initialData.searchResult.itemStacks[0] holds both 'meta.totalItemCount' (exact site-computed total) and the literal 'items' array (used for de-dup/content verification only). QTY METHOD: used meta.totalItemCount as qty, NOT the raw 'items' array length or the top-level 'count'/'gridItemsCount' fields (those are inflated by 1 unlabelled AdPlaceholder entry per page, same defect the Home-Decor pass documented). Cross-validated meta.totalItemCount as exact (not the '(N+)' display's apparent approximation) on the two multi-page categories found: Dog Treats page1(45 unique)+page2(10 unique)=55 == meta 55; Pet Accessories/feeding-accessories-2024 page1(45)+page2(14)=59 == meta 59 -- exact match in both cases, so meta.totalItemCount is trusted site-truth throughout, including single-page categories where the raw ad-slot-stripped item count ran 1 below meta (e.g. Dog Food: 39 raw vs meta 40) -- treated as one SKU present in the count but not rendered in the SSR payload (e.g. hidden/oos variant), not as an inflation artifact. GROUPING: 'Pet Accessories' (catId 2024) is the real parent of Dog Beds(2021)/Dog Accessories(2029)/Cat Accessories(9259) -- confirmed via their shared breadCrumb ['All Departments','Pet Supplies','Pet Accessories']; made it a grouping row instead of double-counting its own 59-count against its children's 12+17+20=49 (the gap is other facets with no dedicated nav tile). 'Flea & Tick Care' (catId 15370153) is likewise parent of Dog Flea & Tick Care(2360135, breadcrumb '...>Flea & Tick Care') and Cat Flea & Tick Care(2400101, same breadcrumb) -- children's real-product sum (13+18-...=~18) matches the parent's own de-duped unique count (18) almost exactly, confirming the relationship; made it a grouping row rather than counting it a third time. EXCLUDED, not emitted as rows: 'New!'/'Savings'/'Shareable Packs' (facet-filtered promo/marketing tiles off the top hub, explicitly excluded category types per brief); 'Pet Insurance' (external link to quote.spotpet.com, a quote form, not a PLP); "Member's Mark Pet Supplies" (catId 17080255, breadcrumb 'Member's Mark Products' -- a brand rollup, not a product-type category; its sample items are the same SKUs already counted under Dog Food/Dog Treats/Pet Beds, e.g. 'Member's Mark Chicken Jerky Recipe Dog Treats' appears verbatim in both); 'Puppy Essentials' (catId 15720501 -- a curated new-puppy starter-kit merchandising bucket, breadcrumb sits at the bare 'Pet Supplies' level not under Dogs, and its sample items duplicate Dog Food/Dog Treats/Pet Accessories SKUs already counted, e.g. 'Member's Mark Grain Free Salmon and Sweet Potato Dry Dog Food' appears in both Dog Food and here); 'Smart Pet' (catId 3450119, breadcrumb 'Electronics & Computers > Cool Tech & Gadgets' -- a cross-department gadget collection mixing wild-bird tech (Birdfy feeders/cameras, not owned-pet care) with Petkit items that duplicate SKUs already counted under Dog/Cat Accessories); 'Wildlife Supplies' (catId 16700408, breadcrumb 'Outdoor & Patio > Lawn & Garden' -- wild bird feeders/birdseed/squirrel supplies for backyard wildlife, not owned pets; out of Pet Care scope per the boundary rules despite one stray dog-kennel item bleeding into the results). ABSENCE CHECK: navigated the full Pet Care hub tree (Pet Care -> Dogs/Cats/Pet Accessories/Flea & Tick/Supplements/Medication) plus the 4 excluded tiles above; no dedicated Dog Collars/Leashes/Harnesses, Cat Trees/Scratchers, Pet Carriers/Travel, Pet Clothing, Pet Gates/Crates, or Pet Grooming-tools category exists as its own nav tile anywhere in this tree -- those product types (if carried at all) live unlabelled inside the broad 'Dog Accessories'/'Cat Accessories' buckets already counted. Did not rely on site search (banned as sole absence proof per brief); relied on the embedded nav-module JSON, which is exhaustive for this page type. All qty values below are single evidence-bearing fetches, not re-derived or estimated. Not treated as a duplicate company (no prior Pet Care S.N. for samsclub.com in this batch).
